name: NEVKO-UI
texts: Add a header button with a menu to launch Big Picture or SteamVR
Animate stickers in the menu on hover or always
Apply blur effect to your account/login name
Apply blur effect to your wallet balance
Automatically pass the age check on store pages
Change how round avatars with a profile frame look
Change how round message bubbles look
Change how round or sharp avatars look throughout Steam
Change how round or sharp buttons look throughout Steam
Choose what the account button in the header shows
Display special badges for theme contributors on their profiles
Dock the emoticon menu as a side panel on click
Emoji look in the emoticon menu (sets are loaded from the internet)
Exact Time: 'Last seen: Today at 14:00' | Disable: keeps '3 hours ago', only renames the label
Hide specific elements from the achievements tab
Hide specific elements from the library home screen
Hide the 'Unread Messages' group in the friends list
Hide the Friends / Chats tabs above the list
Hide unread message counters next to friends
Place emoticon and attachment buttons outside or inside the message field
Refresh: redesigned context menus | Legacy: default Steam menus
Remove shiny effect on game card hover.
Remove the profile button from the left side | Useful buttons are moved to Account Menu
Replaces default indicator with a modern dot-style badge
Show Steam emoticons as pictures while typing
Show avatars beside messages in one-on-one chats
Show group chats above or below recent chats
Show header buttons as text, icons, or both
Show the Big Picture or Mobile mark next to your status (applied on Steam launch)
Show the friend's mini profile background behind the chat header
Show your own messages on the right or on the left
Shrink the downloads button in the header to an icon with a progress bar
Size of emoticons in the emoticon menu
Size of stickers in the emoticon menu
Swap the positions of 'Store' and 'Library' buttons in the header
Tab opened on Steam launch (Chats requires the Recent Chats plugin)
Toggle visibility of custom username icon
